workarounds.symptom: Web frontend spawn raises NameError: no_window_creation_flags not imported in start_web_frontend and _loop
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(worker): import no_window_creation_flags at both web spawn sites. Target files: openprogram/worker/web.py, tests/component/worker/test_web_frontend_spawn_imports.py, docs/reference/design/runtime/web-frontend-spawn.html. `start_web_frontend` and `_loop` call `no_window_creation_flags()` while resolving it as a module global that `web.py` never defines, so spawning the web frontend raises `NameError`. (Ref: https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/pull/39)
